summary: Hetz Ventures describes itself as Israel's seed fund for AI infrastructure and cyber. Its homepage says it leads rounds, puts founders in front of a network of data and security executives, and highlights partner programmes with Databricks, Snowflake, Confluent and Grafana. The news section links seed rounds such as Keewano ($12,000,000) and Arrakis ($8,000,000). The team page names the managing partner and general partners. Check size, an application form and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage links a news item on Keewano raising a $12 million seed round to build a database for AI agents. The date is not shown on the homepage.
The homepage links a news item on Arrakis raising an $8M seed round to secure AI agents. The date is not shown on the homepage.

sources.title: Homepage: Israel seed fund for AI infrastructure and cyber, lead role, news links
